# Objective

The pinned quest.

`LL.Objective` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Objective kicker="Quest" title="The First Hunt" objective="Defeat wolves" current={3} required={5}>{tracker}</LL.Objective>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Objective"></x-import>
```
